scope: P1 assembly with integral one-piece charging cover and two nominal motor lead sweeps. Original source shapes conserved (old cover construction-only); new hard parts and motor wires clear their static/plug sample scopes. charging_wiring.scope: Conditional nominal wire envelopes and four equal-length flex shapes, not a continuous flexible-wire or complete-cover motion proof. J1 numeric X order is native-board verified; Y/Z wire exits assume the nominal mate-envelope centre. Actual prewired lead exit, OD <=0.60, permitted bend radius <=1.50 mm, current rating, strip/termination and hand-dressed closure require a received-part trial. First bend2.0mm; other bends1.5mm. Nominal pack-mate gap about0.508mm is not a tolerance margin or physical acceptance. Do not force a thicker/stiffer lead into this route. No pack/BOM/PCB change.
